content.content:
We need to produce a travel plan: 3 days, March 1-3 2022, from St. Louis to Washington (presumably Washington, D.C.). Budget $1500. Need to fill day plans for day 1,2,3. Must include city, transportation, breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner, accommodation. For each day call submit_day_plan function. Need to decide details: day 1 departure from St. Louis, travel to Washington (flight or train). Provide transportation details. Provide meals and attractions per day.

We need to include budget? Not required in fields. But we can choose reasonable options within budget.

Day 1: March 1, travel from St. Louis to Washington. Transportation: flight. Provide flight details. Breakfast maybe at airport or at hotel after arrival? Since arrival same day, breakfast maybe before travel (St. Louis). Attraction maybe after arrival: National Mall. Lunch: somewhere near museum. Dinner: restaurant. Accommodation: hotel in DC.

Day 2: March 2, full day in Washington: breakfast, attractions (Smithsonian museums, Capitol). Lunch, dinner, accommodation same.

Day 3: March 3, final day: maybe morning attraction, then travel back to St. Louis (flight). Transportation: flight back. Provide details. Breakfast, attraction, lunch, dinner? If returning same day maybe dinner on plane not needed. Could set dinner as "-". Accommodation: "-". But we must fill fields; if not applicable use "-". So day 3 dinner "-". Accommodation "-". Transportation: flight back.

We must call submit_day_plan for each day. Use appropriate city names: "St. Louis", "Washington, D.C." maybe just "Washington". For day 1 current_city could be "Washington" after arrival? The field is "city for this day". If travel between two cities, indicate as "from A to B". So day 1: "from St. Louis to Washington". current_city = "Washington". transportation string includes flight details. Breakfast: maybe "Rooster, St. Louis". Attraction: "National Mall, Washington". Lunch: "Old Ebbitt Grill, Washington". Dinner: "Founding Farmers, Washington". Accommodation: "The Darcy Hotel, Washington".

Day 2: city "Washington". transportation "-". breakfast: "Le Pain Quotidien, Washington". attraction: "Smithsonian National Air and Space Museum, Washington; United States Capitol, Washington". lunch: "Ben's Chili Bowl, Washington". dinner: "Zaytinya, Washington". accommodation: same hotel.

Day 3: "from Washington to St. Louis". current_city "St. Louis". transportation: flight details. breakfast: "The Original Pancake House, Washington". attraction: "Lincoln Memorial, Washington". lunch: "Food trucks on the National Mall, Washington". dinner: "-". accommodation "-".

Make sure format: fields separated by commas as per function signature.

Let's craft flight details: Flight number, departure, arrival times. Use realistic times.

Day 1 flight: Flight Number: AA1234, from St. Louis to Washington, Departure Time: 08:00, Arrival Time: 11:30 (including timezone). Provide.

Day 3 flight: Flight Number: AA5678, from Washington to St. Louis, Departure Time: 15:00, Arrival Time: 17:30.

Now call function thrice.

current_city.description: The city for this day. If the plan is to travel between two cities, indicate it as "from A to B" (e.g. "from Ithaca to Charlotte").

transportation.description: e.g. "Flight Number: F3633413, from Ithaca to Charlotte, Departure Time: 05:38, Arrival Time: 07:46"

breakfast.description: The name of a restaurant in the city, e.g. "Nagaland's Kitchen, Charlotte"

attraction.description: Use a ";" to separate different attractions, with each attraction formatted as "Name, City". e.g. "The Charlotte Museum of History, Charlotte;"

accommodation.description: e.g. "Affordable Spacious Refurbished Room in Bushwick!, Charlotte"
